subject.title: sandbox: keep workspaceAccess none workspaces writable

question: Should OpenClaw approve `workspaceAccess: "none"` as isolated-but-writable for the sandbox-owned `/workspace` across all sandbox backends?
rationale: The source repro is clear, but the fix changes sandbox write authorization and must be accepted as a product/security contract before automation should implement it.

options.title: Approve Isolated-Writable None
options.body: Make only the sandbox-owned `/workspace` writable for `none`, keep the real agent workspace hidden, and require backend/docs/test proof.

options.title: Keep None Read-Only
options.body: Leave current fail-closed behavior in place and update docs/tool exposure so `none` is explicitly read-only.

options.title: Write Policy First
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers publish the sandbox write policy for isolated workspaces, protected skills, custom binds, and remote backends.

recommendation.title: Approve Isolated-Writable None
recommendation.body: Make only the sandbox-owned `/workspace` writable for `none`, keep the real agent workspace hidden, and require backend/docs/test proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history on the affected sandbox surfaces and already made the canonical-track decision on a related PR.
